Permanent terminal placement/depth, WATCH OUT, actual car damage, original vehicles, Cross controls, jump/drop, lift, music and boss sequence retained.
coverage: All central Jammer slots from both world ends; retained lift exclusion; >=800-unit boss pan from rightmost normal attack position.
12 full RAF/update/render traffic routes at 30/60/120Hz, natural original cars, WATCH OUT and real health 3→2 in training and mission.
Actual Chromium muted autoplay, presented video pixels, invariant drawing dimensions, full natural loop, production pause/stop, reset/restart/disposal, and fallback to original city.
Required full regression suite and existing Chromium intro route.
